confirmation_rule.procedure: Retain the six construction-view memberships from seed 20261122. Independently reconstruct the six selectors on untouched seed 20261124 and compare the six-bank ordering for every summary coordinate.
confirmation_rule.rank_statistic: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties
confirmation_rule.aggregate_gate: Every finite nonconstant summary coordinate must pass. A coordinate that is constant in both views is recorded as stable with correlation 1.0; a coordinate constant in only one view fails.
confirmation_rule.failure_action: abstain before development training or version a new protocol

revision_reason: The version 1 bank contract bound seeds 20261120 and 20261121. Those views failed the measurement diversity gate and cannot authorize development banks. Version 2 binds the passing v3 construction view and a new untouched confirmation view while leaving every selector, coordinate, bank size, statistic, and threshold unchanged.
